protected_invariants: HISTORICAL_ECONNRESET_ATTEMPT_IMMUTABLE: the consumed ECONNRESET request, candidate, authorization, run id, request id, ledger entries and runtime evidence are never modified, reused, retried or reclassified

TRANSPORT_FAILURE_IS_CONSUMED_AND_TERMINAL: a post-boundary transport exception remains TRANSPORT_FAILURE_AFTER_POSSIBLE_TRANSMISSION with local budget consumed, no automatic retry, no RAW, no receipt and no transaction
DIAGNOSTICS_ARE_PROSPECTIVE_ONLY: new immutable transport diagnostics are future evidence only and cannot retroactively reconstruct the historical ECONNRESET

SECRET_SAFE_TRANSPORT_DIAGNOSTICS: only bounded allowlisted direct error fields and fixed provenance are retained; stack, cause, arbitrary fields, credentials, authorization, cookies, proxy URLs, preflight secrets and bodies never enter artifacts
LEDGER_FIRST_PERSISTENCE: durable terminal accounting precedes transport-diagnostic persistence, and diagnostic persistence failure cannot resurrect authority or permit retry
NO_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ACTIVITY: all validation uses fake/local transports and passive evidence only; zero provider requests, DNS lookups and quota probes
MERGE_AUTHORIZED_BY_OWNER_ON_EXACT_GREEN_HEAD: one squash merge is allowed only after CRITICAL exact-head Codex and DeepSeek review, required CI, merge readiness and post-merge Production Gate
forbidden_side_effects: contacting or resolving The Odds API, creating a live authorization, consuming authorization, creating request intent, crossing transmission boundary, making a provider request, probing quota or starting scheduler/continuous operations

editing historical ledger entries or runtime evidence, retrying the spent ECONNRESET request, reusing the spent candidate/authorization/run/request identifiers, or changing provider configuration/secrets
storing or logging provider credentials, proxy credentials, HMAC secrets, authorization values, cookies, arbitrary reflected error objects or secret-bearing response data
modifying PR #1914, unrelated provider/proxy architecture, bookmaker registry semantics, training, prediction, backtest, value betting or reviewer policy
